<issue>
[SM6.10] Thread scope Multiply output K Vec
**Description**
From https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/blob/8cb7673ef546be2d9965ad19715727314702be82/tools/clang/lib/Headers/hlsl/dx/linalg.h#L468

typename hlsl::enable_if<hlsl::is_arithmetic<InputElTy>::value, vector<**OutputElTy, K**> >::type
// clang-format on
Multiply(Matrix<MatrixDT, M, K, MatrixUse::A, MatrixScope::Thread> MatrixA,
         vector<InputElTy, K> Vec) {
  **vector<OutputElTy, M> Result;**
  __builtin_LinAlg_MatrixVectorMultiply(Result, MatrixA.__handle,
                                        hlsl::is_signed<OutputElTy>::value, Vec,
                                        MatrixDT);
  return Result;
}

the output vector length is M or K?

**Steps to Reproduce**

input.instruction: In /testbed/tools/clang/lib/Headers/hlsl/dx/linalg.h, find all functions named Multiply / MultiplyAdd with Thread scope matrices (MatrixScope::Thread) and print them with line numbers (around line 460-500). Also grep tests (tools/clang/test) for 'vector<.*K>' related to linalg Multiply to report.

content.content: {"summary":"linalg.h has five Thread-scope Multiply/MultiplyAdd overloads (one Multiply, four MultiplyAdd), all taking a MatrixUse::A Thread-scope matrix and a vector, with no Thread-scope matrix-matrix Multiply. The test directory has no test matching 'vector<.*K>' for linalg Multiply. Printed the code only with the grep line numbers; no files were modified.","findings":["linalg.h:470 Multiply(Matrix<MatrixDT,M,K,A,Thread> MatrixA, vector<InputElTy,K> Vec) -> vector<OutputElTy,M>, calls __builtin_LinAlg_MatrixVectorMultiply (body ~471-476)","linalg.h:484 MultiplyAdd(MatrixA, vector<InputElTy,M> Vec, vector<BiasElTy,K> Bias) -> vector<OutputElTy,K>, calls __builtin_LinAlg_MatrixVectorMultiplyAdd (~485-490)","linalg.h:501 MultiplyAdd overload taking a vector<InputElTy,M> with a bias vector<BiasElTy,K> (~501-510), calls __builtin_LinAlg_MatrixVectorMultiplyAdd","linalg.h:517 MultiplyAdd overload (~517-527), calls __builtin_LinAlg_MatrixVectorMultiplyAdd","linalg.h:537 MultiplyAdd overload with InterpretedVector<InputElTy,VecM,InputInterp> input, enable_if on Size==M (~537-548)","Section comment 'Cooperative Vector Replacement API' at linalg.h:~457-458; Thread-scope Matrix class at linalg.h:385; OuterProduct Thread-scope at linalg.h:552-556 (not Multiply, listed for context)","tools/clang/test: grep for 'vector<.*K>' combined with multiply/linalg returned zero matches; linalg tests exist under tools/clang/test/CodeGenDXIL/hlsl/linalg/builtins/ (e.g. matrixvectormultiply/nominal.hlsl, matrixvectormultiplyadd/nominal.hlsl) but contain no vector<...> matches"],"confidence":0.8}
